fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) surged 130.2% over the past 12 months, significantly outpacing the Zacks computer and technology sector's 2.9% gain.
fields.summary_ko.1: AI infrastructure business is the primary growth driver, recording $131.7B in AI server orders over the past 12 months, with AI server revenue expected to reach approximately $74B in fiscal 2027, roughly 3x prior year.
fields.summary_ko.2: Traditional server and networking revenue reached $10.5B in fiscal Q2, up 122% YoY, and with over 6,500 AI customers acquired, further adoption opportunities are expanding.
